note: A starting point, not a universal AI-slop list. Point VOICE_PROFILE at your own profile to replace it. A rule belongs here only if it almost never appears in your own writing and shows up often in machine drafts.

paired_dashes.guidance: two dashes bracketing an aside in one sentence. Split the sentence, or use commas or parentheses.

en_dash.guidance: an en dash between words. Use a spaced hyphen or an em dash.

spellings.guidance: a British spelling. Use American English.

crowd_list_audit.lesson: A crowd-sourced slop list is a hypothesis generator, not a ruleset. Measure every candidate against the author's own writing before adopting it.

rejected.note: Common candidates that are ordinary vocabulary for many writers. Measure against your own writing before adding any of them.
common_words: at the end of the day
